name: Android APK
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]

jobs:
  android:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
      - name: Install Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v4
        with:
          packages: "platform-tools"
      - name: Install Godot and templates
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GODOT_VERSION=4.4.1
          wget -q "https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/${GODOT_VERSION}-stable/Godot_v${GODOT_VERSION}-stable_linux.x86_64.zip" -O /tmp/godot.zip
          unzip -q /tmp/godot.zip -d /tmp
          sudo install -m755 "/tmp/Godot_v${GODOT_VERSION}-stable_linux.x86_64" /usr/local/bin/godot
          wget -q "https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/${GODOT_VERSION}-stable/Godot_v${GODOT_VERSION}-stable_export_templates.tpz" -O /tmp/templates.tpz
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/share/godot/export_templates/${GODOT_VERSION}.stable"
          unzip -q /tmp/templates.tpz -d /tmp/godot_templates
          cp /tmp/godot_templates/templates/* "$HOME/.local/share/godot/export_templates/${GODOT_VERSION}.stable/"
      - name: Create debug signing key
        run: |
          keytool -genkeypair -noprompt -keystore "$RUNNER_TEMP/debug.keystore" -alias androiddebugkey -storepass android -keypass android -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 -dname "CN=Android Debug,O=Goblin Defense,C=US"
          echo "GODOT_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_DEBUG_PATH=$RUNNER_TEMP/debug.keystore" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "GODOT_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_DEBUG_USER=androiddebugkey" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "GODOT_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_DEBUG_PASSWORD=android" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Import project
        run: godot --headless --path . --editor --import --quit
      - name: Export APK
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          godot --headless --path . --export-debug "Android" build/GoblinDefense-debug.apk
          test -s build/GoblinDefense-debug.apk
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: GoblinDefense-Android-APK
          path: build/GoblinDefense-debug.apk
